scope: One complete private-profile window with notice, optional measurements and readiness, following merged PR #35.
background_strategy: Reuse the exact existing PixelLab guild entrance; no new background generation required.
visual_review: Three separate landscape images, each one a complete screen; no contact sheet.
Spanish content legible without visible overlapping or cropped controls.
170 cm and 70 kg are fictional review values, never inferred user measurements.
Unit selection is independent of optional height/weight; appearance is unchanged.
Readiness begins unselected and includes a pause action. Selection must be mutually exclusive.
Generated art is only a reference: runtime keeps original native background and existing sprite controls unchanged.
Normalize the header to the text-only step indicator in the measurements reference; the notice-only decorative circles are not required.
Runtime must display the same compact review marker on all three states; the readiness concept omitted it.
implementation_constraints: No profile runtime code changed in this concept stage.
Keep preview drafts in memory with explicit review context, separate from production auth, eligibility and health-data authorization.
The previous PR provisional registration does not create an identity; do not bypass that boundary to collect live profile data.
Production measurement entry remains gated by its existing authorization requirements; final legal copy does not block the concept or review flow.
Ready or low-energy selection continues only to reviewed setup, not automatic training or approval of Hard difficulty.
Pain, injury, illness or uncertainty leads to a pause; daily readiness is checked again before a routine.
Metric/imperial conversion preserves canonical values; blank optional values remain absent.
Goals/experience, equipment and schedule are subsequent windows; appearance never prescribes exercise.
No BMI, calorie, weight target, new character art, animation or art credit batch.
